decision_authority: T1-G2 via explicitly authorized Git-capable publication executor

prepare.effect: No authoritative root changes; validate candidate bytes, declared access scope, schema, identity, generation, provenance and dependencies.
prepare.read_set: Commit-pinned paths/record selectors with exact-byte hashes; missing-object reads must declare exists=false.
prepare.write_set: Explicit ADD/SUPERSEDE_POINTER/APPEND_SEGMENT proposals with expected prior hash; no destructive edit of immutable source/event/return.
prepare.undeclared_dependency: BLOCK and amend/reprepare; never ignore undeclared reads/writes.

preconditions: Current main and state root match expected base, or newly PREPARED after scoped semantic rebase
All read_set expected hashes/existence still match
Candidate objects fully sealed/verified and validation PASS
commit.atomicity: One main commit publishes objects, commit decision record and new root together; Git ref update must use expected parent and non-force push. Candidate reachability alone before root commit grants no semantic authority.
commit.optimistic_concurrency: If HEAD changed, perform lightweight sync and compare declared dependencies. Disjoint changes still require refreshed PREPARE at current HEAD; overlapping semantic changes require three-way merge base/current/proposal preserving conflicts. No last-write-wins.
commit.outcome: New root references committed object/decision hashes. Root manifest records base/parent commit; publishing commit is externally observed to avoid hash cycles.

abort.effect: Append ABORT decision with reason and candidate refs; authoritative root remains previous verified root.
abort.after_commit: Cannot ABORT an already committed transaction; issue explicit compensating transaction.
abort.idempotency: Same ID/key and identical proposal may replay; divergent ID/key reuse quarantined.

phase8a.bootstrap_publication: Additive metadata publication at exact base; initial root binds pre-existing MRE2 bytes. No engineering delta transaction is manufactured.

record_identity: transaction_id identifies the lifecycle; phase records are immutable under (transaction_id, phase, transaction_hash). Repeated identical phase record is idempotent; divergent repeated phase record quarantined. COMMIT prepare_hash equals the PREPARE record transaction_hash.
